name: crimtail
label: Should police tail a known criminal?

questions.text:
Suppose the police get an anonymous tip that a man with a long criminal record is planning to break into a warehouse. Please circle a number for each question to show if you think police should be allowed without a court order to ... 
A. Keep the man under surveillance.
questions.stem: Suppose the police get an anonymous tip that a man with a long criminal record is planning to break into a warehouse. Please circle a number for each question to show if you think police should be allowed without a court order to ...
questions.item: A. Keep the man under surveillance.
